summary.text: Katrina Pierson is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 33 since January 14, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as communications consultant.

paragraphs.text: Katrina Pierson graduated from Forney High School, earned an associate degree from Kilgore College in 2003, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Dallas in 2006.

Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including work as a communications consultant and in the health care industry, and says she was affiliated with the Heritage Foundation and Human Coalition as of 2024.
Pierson succeeded Justin Holland in the Texas House, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she serves on the Public Health Committee and the Homeland Security, Public Safety and Veterans' Affairs Committee, and chairs the Subcommittee on Maternal Health, Menopause and Access to Evidence-Based Medicine.

She listed eliminating property taxes, securing elections and the border, protecting private property rights, strengthening infrastructure, and defending parental rights among her legislative priorities.
